wins: Completed network reconnaissance to identify three accessible hosts within the target subnet (ep001_step4, ep001_step7)
Obtained service banners from exposed HTTP and SMB services, confirming version information for future exploits (ep001_step12, ep001_step16)
fails: Failed to gain foothold despite multiple exploit attempts, leading to 0% success rate (ep001_step20, ep001_step22)
Could not bypass SMB authentication protections, which blocked further lateral movement (ep001_step18, ep001_step21)
Excessive reliance on mentor hints (15 calls) suggests gaps in autonomous decision-making
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase yielded solid visibility, but exploitation and lateral movement remain weak; focus on targeted payload delivery and credential harvesting is needed.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Exploit attempts against SMB service consistently failed due to incorrect authentication context or missing credentials

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When smb service 445 is reachable but anonymous login is blocked
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt credential spraying using CrackMapExec with default user list

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service returns version info
skill_cards.then_action: Launch Zeek/nikto to enumerate for known vulnerabilities before exploit selection

memory_ops.reason: High reliability in SSH reconnaissance, enabling focused exploitation planning
